Condition variable definitions.

```c
#include <sync/cv.h>
```

## Structures

### `CondVariable` { #condvariable }

Struct representing a condition variable.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `seq` | `_Atomic uint32_t` | Wakeup generation. Bumped by every signal and broadcast. |
| `waiters` | `_Atomic int` | The number of threads currently inside CondVarWait(). |
| `sem` | [`Semaphore`](sem.md#semaphore) | The semaphore waiting threads block on. |

## Functions

### `CondVarInit` { #condvarinit }

```c
Err CondVarInit(CondVariable *cv);
```

Initialize a condition variable with no waiters.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `cv` | in | The condition variable to initialize. |

**Returns:** ZUZU_OK on success, negative error code if the underlying semaphore couldn't be created.

### `CondVarDestroy` { #condvardestroy }

```c
Err CondVarDestroy(CondVariable *cv);
```

Destroy a condition variable.

No thread may be waiting on it.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `cv` | in | The condition variable to destroy. |

**Returns:** ZUZU_OK on success, ERR_BUSY if the underlying semaphore cannot be destroyed.

### `CondVarSignal` { #condvarsignal }

```c
Err CondVarSignal(CondVariable *cv);
```

Wake one thread waiting on a condition variable.

Does nothing if no thread is waiting. The caller normally holds the zone that protects the condition, but doesn't have to.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `cv` | in | The condition variable to signal. |

**Returns:** ZUZU_OK.

### `CondVarBroadcast` { #condvarbroadcast }

```c
Err CondVarBroadcast(CondVariable *cv);
```

Wake every thread waiting on a condition variable.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `cv` | in | The condition variable to signal. |

**Returns:** ZUZU_OK.

### `CondVarWait` { #condvarwait }

```c
Err CondVarWait(CondVariable *cv, Zone *z);
```

Release a zone, wait to be signaled, and take the zone again.

The caller must hold `z`. It is released before blocking and held again when this returns, so the condition must be re-checked in a loop: a wakeup does not guarantee it still holds.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `cv` | in | The condition variable to wait on. |
| `z` | in | The zone that protects the condition; held on entry and on return. |

**Returns:** ZUZU_OK.
